- Added a narrow sidebar mode in theme settings, so navigation can show icons only with page names on hover and animate between both widths while keeping your choice; the sidebar style is adapted from https://github.com/OGC-CGC/stelliberty with thanks
- Fixed an issue with subscription providers that previously synchronized only once per session; repeated updates now stay available

---

- 新增了主题设置中的窄侧边栏模式，导航可以只显示图标并在悬停时显示页面名称，两种宽度之间的切换带过渡动画，同时记住你的选择；侧边栏风格参考 https://github.com/OGC-CGC/stelliberty，特此感谢
- 修复了订阅提供者每个会话只能同步一次的问题，现在可以反复更新
